subcommittees.name: Commodity Markets, Digital Assets, and Rural Development Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects telecommunications entities and applicants seeking communications use authorizations on public lands and National Forest System land.
dimensions.evidence: requests for easements, rights-of-way, leases, licenses, or other authorizations to locate or modify a transmitting device, support structure, or other communications facility on public lands

dimensions.assessment: Streamlines application processing through online portals rather than creating new substantive property rights.
dimensions.evidence: establish an online portal for accepting, processing, and disposal of applications for communications use authorizations

dimensions.assessment: No specific appropriations or fiscal impacts are mentioned in the source material.
Administrative requirement for two federal departments to create online submission portals.
Permanent operational requirement following a one-year implementation deadline.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretaries concerned shall each establish... an online portal

missing_information: Cost to build and maintain the online portals.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of the Interior and the Forest Service to establish online portals for communications use authorization applications on public and forest lands.
